categories.main_business_segments: Consun Pharmaceutical Group operates primarily in the manufacturing and sales of pharmaceutical products, focusing on nephrology, imaging, gynaecology and paediatrics, and retail pharmaceutical business through Yulin Pharmaceutical. The nephrology segment is the largest contributor, followed by gynaecology and paediatrics, medical contrast media, orthopedics, dermatologic, and hepatobiliary medicines. The Group also engages in retail OTC and prescription drug sales via Yulin Pharmaceutical.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group emphasizes both independent and cooperative R&D, focusing on innovative drugs and biopharmaceuticals, with advanced production processes including automation and intelligent manufacturing systems. It has developed proprietary products such as Uremic Clearance Granules and various contrast agents, and collaborates with research institutions for drug development and clinical trials. Quality management follows a full life-cycle system with continuous technological upgrades and compliance with national standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Consun serves a diversified customer base including hospitals, medical institutions, and retail pharmacies across China. Key customers include entities involved in centralized procurement programs. The Group’s products target patients with nephropathy, chronic diseases, iron deficiency anemia, and other medical conditions, with a focus on both hospital and retail end-users.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates primarily in Mainland China, with headquarters in Guangzhou and significant operations in Inner Mongolia, Guangxi, Xinjiang, and Horgos. It also maintains principal business offices and liaison offices in Hong Kong. The Group’s sales and marketing network covers nationwide China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Consun Pharmaceutical operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, including drug manufacturing, R&D, marketing, and distribution. It also manages retail pharmaceutical sales through its subsidiary Yulin Pharmaceutical, positioning itself close to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven growth, emphasizing R&D in nephrology, imaging, and gynaecology and paediatrics. It pursues independent and collaborative R&D projects, including clinical trials for innovative drugs, and post-launch medical research. The Group aims to enhance product quality, expand centralized procurement coverage, and leverage digital transformation and scientific marketing to strengthen competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pharmaceutical products, including prescription medicines, OTC drugs, and medical contrast media. The Group also benefits from government grants and engages in brand-building and marketing activities to support sales growth. Revenue is recognized mainly at the point of product delivery to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Consun Pharmaceutical is positioned as a leading player in the modern Chinese medicine market, particularly in nephrology where its flagship product maintains market leadership. The industry is highly competitive with traditional pharmaceutical companies transitioning to innovative drugs and emerging biotech firms gaining ground. Consun differentiates through its focus on innovation, academic promotion, and compliance with evolving regulatory policies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB2.97 billion, a 14.6% increase year-on-year, and a profit attributable to equity shareholders of RMB0.91 billion, up 16.1%. Total assets reached RMB5.85 billion with equity of RMB4.10 billion. The Group maintains a healthy liquidity position with net cash and a low gearing ratio of 6.2%, reflecting steady growth and robust financial health.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Consun emphasizes high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical products with strong academic and clinical backing, particularly in nephrology and traditional Chinese medicine. Its flagship products are guideline-recommended and supported by scientific research. The Group leverages integrated R&D, production excellence, and scientific marketing to deliver differentiated value, ensuring compliance and responsiveness to policy changes, thereby securing customer trust and market leadership.
